title: Unit
description: One retrieval unit: a section of a page, the thing a hit refers to and `embed` embeds.

heading.description: The unit's heading, empty for the page's intro.

ordinal.description: 0-based position of the unit within its page, in document order.

text.description: Title, heading and body joined into one text worth embedding.
